job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design and development of scalable, distributed AI-driven software systems, ensuring high performance and reliability.
- Translate complex business requirements into technical specifications and guide the engineering team in their implementation.
- Oversee the technical execution of projects, ensuring adherence to high standards of code quality and project deadlines.
- Develop and deploy LLM-based pipelines, enhancing AI solutions with patterns like RAG and agentic workflows.
- Manage the full software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis to deployment, with a focus on achieving defined product goals.
- Leverage cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and GCP to enhance system capabilities and maintain robust infrastructure support.
- Implement DevOps practices using tools like Docker and Kubernetes to ensure seamless integration and continuous delivery.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, conduct code reviews, and provide mentorship to foster a culture of innovation and technical excellence.

Overview

- The AI LLM Engineer Manager at our leading consulting firm in Bangalore will play a crucial role in spearheading the development of cutting-edge AI-driven solutions.
- Tasked with leading a team of skilled engineers, this role focuses on designing scalable, reliable architectures to meet client needs.
- With the consulting firm's commitment to innovation, the manager will be responsible for translating complex business requirements into actionable technical strategies.
- The emphasis is on leveraging state-of-the-art AI technologies and cloud platforms to enhance performance and system capabilities.
- This position requires a dynamic leader with extensive experience in software development, particularly in the realm of AI and large language models (LLM).
- The manager will ensure the effective execution of projects, maintaining high standards of code quality and project management.
- The role demands a strong acumen in both technical and leadership skills to foster a high-performance culture within the team.
- Our firm prides itself on delivering exceptional consulting services by integrating advanced AI technologies.
- The AI LLM Engineer Manager will play an instrumental role in driving this mission forward, contributing to our legacy of excellence in the consulting sector.
- The manager will be expected to innovate, strategize, and implement AI technologies that align with our strategic goals and client expectations.
- In this leadership position, the manager will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and execution of AI solutions.
- The role requires an individual who is adept at navigating the complexities of AI technologies while driving innovation and excellence within the team.

Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
- At least 7 years of experience in software development, with a focus on AI and LLM solution development.
- Proficiency in Python and JavaScript, with experience in API frameworks like FastAPI and Django.
- Extensive experience with cloud platforms, specifically AWS, Azure, or GCP, and DevOps tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
- Strong understanding of LLM patterns like RAG, Vector DB, and agent development, with experience using LLM APIs and SDKs such as OpenAI and Langchain.
- Experience with Agile methodologies and software engineering practices, including version control (GIT) and DevOps workflows, preferably with Azure DevOps.
- Excellent communication skills, capable of conveying complex technical concepts to diverse audiences effectively.
